claims.statement: Announced total capex of Rs 2,000 crore over ~1-1.5 years for spinning expansion, modernization, fabric debottlenecking, manmade fabric project, and green power
Spinning capex of ~Rs 1,000 crore includes 50,000 spindle equivalent expansion and major modernization to be completed by March-April 2025
Manmade fabric project phase 1 capex ~Rs 330-340 crore for 15 lakh meters/month capacity (70-80% polyester, 20-30% nylon) to be completed in 1.5 years
Green power capex provision of Rs 350-400 crore to increase renewable share from 2-3% to 25-30% within 18 months targeting 4-year payback
Fabric division running at 100% capacity utilization; full year FY24 utilization at 88-90%
Spinning gross margin currently $0.70-0.75/kg vs normal benchmark of $0.90-1.00; expects meaningful margin improvement only when industry utilization reaches 85-90% in 6-9 months
Technical textile margins expected similar to company average (16-18%); fabric margins better than company average
